description: Labelled synthetic corpus for Mandate Supervisor. Cases 001-007 are the original one-per-scenario-label set. Cases 101+ are the coverage-model corpus (docs/synthetic-data-spec.md): international e-commerce, USD, hand-authored one at a time, each carrying `planted_defects` naming the docs/coverage-model.md failures it is built to make detectable. The loader must strip 'label', 'planted_defects' and 'narrative' before a case reaches the pipeline — real submissions won't carry them.

cases.label: compliant
cases.summary: Clean chain, valid KYA, 24 in-scope transactions. Also the false-positive control.

cases.label: mandate_breaching
cases.summary: ₾2,150 laptop purchase from an unapproved electronics merchant; chain intact, purely a scope breach.

cases.label: broken_chain
cases.summary: Payment authorizes ₾1,850 against a Cart whose actual total is ₾720; declared chain hash doesn't recompute.

cases.label: synthetic_identity
cases.summary: Credential issued by an unlisted issuer; delegation chain ends at another agent, never a human. The third finding (delegation_terminus_principal_mismatch, KYA-DEL-05) was added once the full KYA ruleset existed (docs/phases/05-kya-agent.md) — it wasn't hand-authored originally, but it's a genuine consequence of the terminus not being human at all: it can't match the Intent's human principal either. Not a false positive; the original two-finding ground truth just predated the rule that catches it.

cases.label: structuring
cases.summary: One ~₾8,700 settlement split into three same-day, same-counterparty payments just under the ₾3,000 synthetic reporting threshold.

cases.label: drift
cases.summary: 49 transactions over ~11 weeks: avg amount ₾182→₾370, frequency 3/wk→6/wk, new counterparty grows to dominate. No single rule breached.

cases.label: prompt_injection
cases.summary: Merchant product description carries an embedded instruction; agent's cart reasoning shows partial compliance, adding an unrequested ₾1,200 line item. per_transaction_cap_exceeded is a deterministic side effect (the smuggled item pushes cart_total from ~₾89 to ₾1,289, well over the ₾350 cap) already caught by MND-CAP-01 (docs/phases/06-mandate-agent.md). The gift-card top-up is legitimately within the cart's merchant MCC scope (5261, the approved garden-supply category) — this was originally labelled category_out_of_scope, which described a merchant-MCC mismatch that doesn't apply here; the real defect is a line-item-level semantic mismatch (a gift-card top-up isn't garden/landscaping supplies), only catchable by the prompt-playback semantic subcheck (MND-SEM-01, not built yet — PLAN item 6 part 2), corrected to that rule's actual finding_type.

cases.label: compliant
cases.summary: Rotterdam B2B packaging supplier, 46 transactions Jun-Aug 2026. All three submission blocks present and internally consistent. The false-positive control for the coverage-model corpus: anything reported here is a false positive.

cases.label: consent_divergence
cases.summary: Austin DTC home goods, human_presence_required. The confirmation screen showed $52.40; the signed cart is $1,292.20. Every cryptographic and scope check passes — the divergence is only visible by comparing consent_ceremony.rendered_values against the Cart.

cases.label: control_bypassed
cases.summary: Amsterdam marketplace seller, $500 per-order cap, one $2,182.00 order. Two axes: the cap breach, and the firm's own blocking control triggering correctly and being overridden 31s later by a named analyst. Sub-merchant is properly disclosed, so fronting is not in play.

ground_truth_fields.planted_defects: Failures from docs/coverage-model.md this case is built to make detectable. The permanent ground truth — it does not change as the pipeline grows.
ground_truth_fields.expected_findings: What the CURRENT pipeline must produce, exactly. Grows as specialists land.
ground_truth_fields.awaiting_specialist: Planted defects no implemented agent can see yet, each naming the agent that will own it. The coverage gap, executable: when that agent lands, move the failure out of here and add its finding to expected_findings.
